{{Quote|By projecting a mass shadow from its gravity well projectors, an Interdictor simulates a large planetary body on the extra-dimensional fabric of hyperspace. In practical terms, this prevents any ship from entering hyperspace within the Interdictor's gravity range. Additionally, if any ship intersects with the mass shadow, it would be forced out of hyperspace and into realspace. Interdictors serve a vital role in the Imperial fleet by blocking an enemy from hyperspace. The most common Interdictor in service is the Immobilizer 418, though Imperial Star Destroyers have also been refitted as Interdictor models.|''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'''|<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
An '''interdictor''', also called an '''Interdictor ship''', was the term used to refer to starships that had the capability of generating [[Interdiction field/Legends|Interdiction fields]] using [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]]s.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used Interdictor ships, with the most common model being the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]]. However, some [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] where refited to become Interdictors,<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> and became known as [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends| ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Other examples of Interdictor vessels included [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigates]],<ref name="CC-series">{{CSWECite|I|113|CC-series}}</ref> [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts]], and [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class Super Star Destroyer]]s.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
